author: /root
scope: Published-model calibration consistency and independently normalized finite-source Green kernel; no scalar data fit
calculation: Derive nine-pair Newtonian torque and reduce to Eq8.4 in centered geometry; compare direct pair force and independent energy derivative.

Compute real third harmonic by adaptive angular quadrature and by discrete Fourier sums at multiple grids. Infer G from the published computed Ncal only as a model consistency diagnostic; compare the literal +11 exponent and a labeled -11 typographical candidate.

Compute metrology sensitivities and vertical/lateral corrections for the declared equal-sphere model; report all discrepancies without retuning uncertainties, geometry or source rows. Compare reported gamma by arithmetic only.

Derive the cylindrical Yukawa Green identity from point-source normalization and the two-wedge Fourier coefficient. Check independent angular-space versus Bessel-space harmonics and point limits. Never copy the printed extra4pi energy prefactor into a mass-density force law.
controls: Exact algebra, multiple quadratures/FFT grids and finite-difference energy checks; numerical tolerances chosen for consistency only, not acceptance of published experimental claims
development_data: All Lee2020 material already exposed under LAB_OBSERVATION_ACCESS_PLAN_v1.json; any newly read thesis/calibration table remains exposed development
prohibited_shortcuts: No tuning G to call Ncal an independent observation
No assuming per-run centering, covariance or calibration response zero
No action/potential fit or physical exclusion from these computations
No interpreting a source typography or operational failure as new physics
delivery: commits-only support unless a separate substantive checked scientific result warrants a milestone
next_route_if_inputs_missing: Explicit measurement uncertainty envelope or a different source with primitive measurements; do not silently supply the missing data
